Title: NETMESSAGE:One of the pyramid's buttons has been found!
Translation: 金字塔的一个按钮已被找到！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Mission 1: Find four buttons to open the gate to the pyramid.
Translation: 任务1：找到四个按钮以打开通往金字塔的大门。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Commander: Hello group!\n We have had some problems and we need you to sort them out for us.
Translation: 指挥官：大家好！\n 我们遇到了一些问题，需要你们帮我们解决。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Barney insisted on coming and is here to help you out.\nThank you for volunteering. Good Luck!
Translation: 巴尼坚持要来，他在这里协助你们。\n感谢你们的志愿加入。祝好运！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Mission 2: Kill The Pharaoh before his evil power spreads all over the world.
Translation: 任务2：在法老的邪恶力量蔓延全球之前杀死法老。
